scripts.speaker: Keedz
scripts.text:
I don't allow any living person
to come in this place!
What's up?

scripts.speaker: Gigantia
scripts.text:
Just...
Come over here.
I have something
I must do for you.

scripts.speaker: Gigantia
scripts.text:
Your horn is crooked.
Always make sure your horn
is worn straight and neat.
The Lord of Death is always
looking at you.

scripts.speaker: Gigantia
scripts.text:
The Lord of Death knows
and sees all. It's useless
to hide, and escape from
Death's sweet embrace.

scripts.speaker: Gigantia
scripts.text: Hey, wait!

scripts.speaker: Undead Chicken
scripts.text: I lived a peaceful life as a normal chicken. But then came the day I was tragically killed and eaten by humans. Well... Heh heh~! Now it's my turn! *Cackles*

Ouch...!
A chicken...
It bit me!

scripts.speaker: Undead Chicken
scripts.text:
Ho ho~!
I can talk AND feast
on living humans!
Being a zombie is great!
*Cackles*

scripts.speaker: Vatoman
scripts.text:
Oooh, how handy, a living
human~! Fresh blood is
always tasty...! I think I'll just
take a liiittle sip.

Ow! My vein!
Did you just
suck my blood?!

scripts.speaker: Vatoman
scripts.text:
Mwahahaha~
Foolish mortal!
Beware my powers!

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text:
Where...where am I...?
I remember I was sleeping
and when I woke up, I was here...
Mommy, have you seen my mommy?
I wanna go home...*Sob*
About the witch
About the curse
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text: Witch...? I've never seen a witch, but I've read about them in books. I'm not sure if they exist or not, but it would be so horrifying if they did...

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text:
Why is it so cold in here...?
A-aren't you cold, or even scared? I wanna go home... It's warm over there. Could you help me get back... Please...? H-help me...

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text:
A c-curse...?
My grandma says that there are lots of curses in the world. Some of them, you can tell it's a curse. But there are other curses that follow you throughout life...

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text: Grandma says curses can take other forms... Like if someone's always mad at you, and won't forgive you, you can see that as a curse too.

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text: My grandma told me there's only one spell that can break a strong curse that you can't lift with Blessings...

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text:
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...umm...?
What was the last part?
I-I can't remember
the last part of the spell!

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text: If you repeat the spell in that order, it will release you from someone's anger and hate. And if you do it near a bad spirit, they might get the curse instead.

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text: Why are you asking me about these scary kind of things...? I just wanna go home...

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text:
It's so cold in here...
I'm freezing...
And I wanna go home and
get away from this scary place...

scripts.speaker: Alakina Ann
scripts.text:
Please... help me.
Could you take me with you...?

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
I sense you're cursed
by a powerful spell...
Hmm... It's clear what
you must be up to....

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
You wish to get
rid of your curse....
By giving it to me!!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text: Just because I'm a cursed spirit, you adventurers think you can just dump your curses on me?!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
I refuse to let
you remain here.....
Leave now, or I will
remove you by force....

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
....And...
....Whatever you do...
....Do NOT touch my books...
Touch the first book.
Touch the second book.
Touch the third book.
Okay, I am leaving.

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
...!...
How dare you touch my books
when I specifically said
'Don't touch my books!'

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
....!...Grrrrr!
I shall tear you apart...!
Be bound by an eternal curse...!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
...!...
You dare touch my books?!
Right after I said not
to touch them...?!
Foolish mortal!
...BEGONE!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
Muhahahaha....
Stubborn mortal~!
Fine! I will give you
a fighting chance and let
you cast a spell.

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
But Blessings won't
work with the curse
that you have...
And the spell to lift
your curse has been
lost to the ages~!
Clover
Klaatu
Klaytos
Verit
Veritas
Verata
Necktie
Necklace
Nero
^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
You... You broke the curse!
How did you know that spell?!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
What's...
this feeling?

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
No...!
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text: Why did your spell have to work?!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
You...
cast the correct spell?!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
Hoho~
But you're still cursed...

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
You... You broke the curse!
Who taught you that spell?!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
So long as I'm...
still...
cursed.

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text: NOOOOOOOOOO!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Mwahahahaaaa.....!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
Muhahahahahaha!
That's not the right spell!
Now, death awaits you!
You're eternally bound
to the curse...!

scripts.speaker: Ashe Bruce
scripts.text:
Well then.
Try not to trip on
your feet in your
rush to leave.
